definitions: A complex of events, each of which has a positive effect on the next, and which all contribute to a positive outcome.
A situation in which a good outcome leads to another good outcome, which in turn leads back to the first good outcome, creating a cycle of positive development.
examples: The company's success created a virtuous circle of investment and innovation.
Improved education can lead to a virtuous circle of economic growth and social progress.
A virtuous circle of trust and cooperation developed among the team members.
